description: Get the trust verdict for one x402 endpoint: score (0-100), grade (A-F), and verdict (proceed, caution, avoid, free, or insufficient_data), plus uptime, delivery-test status, payout-wallet incidents, and how many independent buyers stand behind the seller's buyer wallets (we count customers, not wallets). Use it when you're deciding whether an endpoint is trustworthy at all, before you have a price quote. When you already have the 402 quote (amount and payTo) and are about to pay, use check_payment instead: it runs this same check and also verifies the price and wallet. To discover good endpoints rather than check a known one, use top_endpoints. Read-only and free; reflects monitoring every 30 minutes and real test payments, so a brand-new endpoint may return insufficient_data. Endpoints not in the catalog return monitored: false. API docs: https://github.com/Book0fEli/lumiere-paycheck/blob/main/docs/api.md

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint including path, exactly as the agent will call it, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1/price.

name: check_endpoint

advice.description: What the verdict means for paying it

auth.description: Present when our paid test was refused for want of the seller's own sign-in (no money was taken). Have access? Send hasAccess: true to check_payment.

required.description: true: the seller needs its own sign-in (account, API key or wallet signature) on top of x402

buyerReports.description: What real buyers reported after paying. Never changes the grade; confirmations move the endpoint up our paid-test queue.

confirmed.description: Buyers (customers or wallets) who reported a usable response in 7 days

ourTestQueued.description: Our own paid test is queued for this endpoint

problems.description: Buyers who reported a problem in 7 days

buyers.description: Who is really behind the seller's buyers. Never changes the grade.

buyerWallets30d.description: Buyer wallets that paid the seller in 30 days

estimated.description: true when counted from a sample of buyers

flags.description: coordinated_wallets, self_funded, concentrated_buyers, shared_operator, estimated, partial_lookup

independentBuyers30d.description: Independent buyers behind the seller's buyer wallets in 30 days (wallets funded from one source count as one)

organicShare.description: 0-1: share of 30-day volume from independent buyers

reviewed.description: false until the seller's buyers have been reviewed (the biggest sellers are reviewed daily)

delivery.description: verified = a real test payment was delivered; failing (see advice: an error after payment that didn't collect the money is D/caution; taking the money and failing is F/avoid); or unverified

exampleInput.description: Present when the listing's own example input got 'not found' when we paid (no money taken): use real input.

forTeams.description: Short note about team plans (per-agent keys, spend limits, audit trail)

grade.description: A delivered cleanly; B delivered with a caveat; C unconfirmed; D doesn't work as listed, no money lost; F costs money or unsafe; ? with too little data

listing.description: Present only when the latest paid response differs from the listing's example or schema. The data is delivered.

capped.description: true: the data is reshaped vs the listing (nested, list vs item), grade capped at B; false: a minor gap, warning only

matchesExample.description: false: the paid response differs from the seller's own example

warning.description: How the real response differs, and where to read the fields

monitored.description: false if the endpoint isn't in the monitored catalog

page.description: Public page with the full history

payToMode.description: fixed, or per_request when the seller issues a new payout address per request

probes.description: Checks counted in the last 7 days

uptimePct.description: Share of checks in the last 7 days that returned a valid payment quote

values.description: Automatic value checks on the latest paid response. A warning caps the grade at B, never avoid.

checked.description: true: automatic value checks passed on the latest paid test

warning.description: A value that looks wrong (wrong subject, stale data, price far from the public spot price)

valuesChecked.description: Latest paid check also passed known-answer value tests

walletUnconfirmed.description: Recent wallet changes nobody could confirm yet

title: Check an x402 endpoint
